name: Kokoro Connect: Yochi Random
original_name: ココロコネクト ヨチランダム
source:
Based on the popular anime and novel series, this PSP visual novel features an original scenario in which the members of the Cultural Research Club begin to experience visions of the future. Interact with your favorite characters as you try to solve the mystery. Features multiple endings, beautiful character art with dynamic, changing expressions, and a "zapping" system that lets you decide from whose point of view you follow the story.

[From [url=http://www.jbox.com/product/PSP9892]JBOX[/url]]
